name: Vitamin A palmitate
explanation: A form of vitamin A used to fortify foods, added in trace amounts. Its name comes from palmitic acid, which is often but not always made from palm. It is not palm oil, and the quantity involved is nothing like a cooking fat.

sources.note: Alias wordings observed in the ingredient statements of imported Indian products.
Written by Prana contributors. Describes what the substance is; contains no health claim and no value copied from a label.

aliases.note: Each alias was seen in at least one imported product.

flags.note: Named for palmitic acid rather than being palm oil. A plain text search for palm reports this as palm oil, which is why it is recorded explicitly.
